notes: Main-split ABox revision of a stored fact (15 queries), kept from the earlier version (the edit was stored, its derivability rated unlikely) and moved to the new layout. The edit crosses a continental boundary (Italy to Tunisia) so the questions discriminate. Related near is the inverse (does Italy still include Elba?); related far reaches Elba by the island of Napoleon's 1814 exile (binding, stored: 'exiled to the Italian island of Elba'). Determinate derived: transitivity (Elba, Tunisia, Africa), inheritance as an application (the legal tender of every place in Tunisia is the dinar) and a composition through Tunis. The old 4-hop continent question and the exile chain query were replaced because determinate derived questions are exactly 2 hops. The indeterminate query is the Portoferraio split of the earlier version. 'Present-day' stays in the far question because Elba was a sovereign principality under Napoleon. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama). Review fixes: negation now reads "Is it true that ... not ..." and every yes/no answer is lowercase; the Chinese question now names the island in English in brackets and the sea (the bare form was missed by Olmo and Mistral); the one-country-per-island step of the related-near question sits in the worlds' shared assumptions (as in the geography template), since located_in itself is many-valued.
